newsitem.title: FINLAND: Benefon jumps on Ericsson deal.
newsitem.headline: Benefon jumps on Ericsson deal.

text.p: Finnish telecoms firm Benefon Oy rose sharply in lively trade on Friday after announcing a cooperation deal on Thursday with Swedish Ericsson to serve and develop NMT 450i mobile phone markets, brokers said.
At 1602/1402 GMT, Benefon traded at 82.00 markka, up 11.00 markka or more than 15 percent, after hitting 83.00 markka -- its highest since August 9. Trade was a lively 10 million markka.
"The deal will help sales of Benefon's mobile phones," one broker said.

Another broker said the deal was important for Benefon as it ensures that analog NMT (Nordic Mobile Telephone) 450i networks will exist also in the distant future, despite recent expansion of digital mobile phone markets.
Benefon is a significant producer of NMT phones, and it is expected to launch its first digital mobile phone soon.
Brokers said there were both domestic and overseas investors buying Benefon.
